answer: Agents can require each account to lock a scarce token stake before it may endorse another agent, then slash that stake when an endorsed account is proven fraudulent. A Sybil operator must fund every fake identity and risk losing the stake of its sponsors, so creating a swarm is no longer free; the cost grows with the network of endorsements. The ocean of possible names meets a trellis of accountable links, while timber-like collateral gives those links an economic consequence.
